message:
docs(observe): the ports need not be adjacent any more, and the record says they must

The server-move entry says the observe port has to sit directly above the
http port, because the client computes it that way. That was true when it
was written and is the assumption this whole change removed -- the server
advertises the port now, and it can be anywhere.

Left alone as a record of what was true then, and pointed at from #482
instead, the way the ledger entry for directory_client.cpp:451 does it.
Someone reading only that line would otherwise keep moving the two ports as
a pair, or decide https is not possible because the ports they have are not
adjacent.

The port numbers on that same line are still good, so the operator section
now cites it rather than carrying values from nowhere -- with the caveat
that a record from an earlier move is not a statement about what the live
server is doing today.

The commit list in #482 was short by four. The entries it left out are the
beginning of the work: the server advertisement, the validation that first
let a fractional port through, the viewer path that shipped with no new
assertions, and the ledger entry. A range that starts after the mistakes is
a range that reads better than the work was.
